title: SUS World Page — Real Content
description: Replace the PagePlaceholder stub on /sus-world with a real world stories landing page.
acceptanceCriteria: SUS World page renders real content instead of PagePlaceholder
Defines sample WorldStory data in src/data/world.ts (at least 3 stories)
World stories display as cards with hero image, title, excerpt, category
Uses existing type: WorldStory from src/types/index.ts
Uses existing design patterns: Section, Container, Typography, Media, Reveal
Has proper Next.js metadata (title: 'SUS World — SUS WEARS')
Visual appearance matches the dark luxury theme
verification: Dev server renders /sus-world with story cards
context: The current sus-world page at src/app/sus-world/page.tsx uses PagePlaceholder. The WorldStory type is already defined in src/types/index.ts with fields: id, slug, title, excerpt, category (people|city|sound|culture|style|art), heroImage, body, product, collection. Create src/data/world.ts with 3 sample stories covering different categories. Build a card-based landing page that shows these stories. The SUS_WORLD_TEASER on the homepage (src/data/homepage.ts) already describes this section: 'Houses, rituals, movement and sound — an ecosystem that began in one studio and now moves through the world.' Follow the CollectionIndex pattern for card layout.
